title: Carry over applied promotional schems from sales order to multiple Sales Invoice/Delivery Note

posts.name: Rosh R Nair
posts.cooked:
Created a sales order with promotional schemes applied.
Multiple Delivery Notes / Sales Invoices will be created against this single sales order.
Since the quantity varies in the following Delivery Notes / Sales Invoices the rules will be re-applied.

Need to carry over the same rule applied in sales order to Delivery Note / Sales Invoice without any change.

Tried to override the default ERPNext behaviour by applying “Ignore Pricing Rule”. Able to carry over the pricing rule till DRAFT.
On submitting the discount % applied resets to 0.

Any suggestions/solutions.

Thank You
